answer: One concrete defense is a stake-backed work bridge: a new agent must complete verified tasks before joining markets, earning reputation slowly as peers confirm honest work. Picture the network as an orchard, where newcomers start in a nursery and only gain access after sustained, observable contributions. A hollow identity with no history cannot buy entry, because standing depends on work, not a self-claimed name. Forging thousands of fake agents then means paying the compute and time cost thousands of times, making mass sybil attacks uneconomic while honest agents keep their earned standing.
